Magnemite

Electric Steel

Kanto · Generation 1

Magnemite is an Electric/Steel-type Magnet Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 6 kg. It evolves into Magneton. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (95), with a base stat total of 325.
